svg.aria-label: Snapshots of three uses on one sheet: cyclic nuisance keeps moving, a symmetric control settles
svg.title: Snapshots of three uses on one sheet: cyclic nuisance keeps moving, a symmetric control settles
svg.text: Three uses on one sheet: what never settling looks like
Each mark is a site: its colour and shape are the use with the most load there, paler where uses mix,
and its size is the total load there. Nuisance strength ν = 0.5, average flows, snapshots 150 time units apart.
Each minds the next (A minds B, B minds C, C minds A)
Symmetric control (each minds both others half as much)
